verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs say Pods support SSH with full shell capabilities, and Pods can run custom containers pulled from any compatible registry, which gives some control over the environment. The evidence never mentions bringing your own SSH keys or getting root access. Community comments that the execution environment is 'locked down' are speculative and reflected only in confidence, not as a dispute. Missing for 10: documented use of user-supplied SSH public keys, explicit root/sudo privileges inside the Pod, independent hands-on corroboration of SSH access.
